def factor_vol_asymmetry_highvol_accel(df):
    """Volatility asymmetry amplified by volume acceleration on high-volume days."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    intraday_ret = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["open"] - 1.0
    up_vol = np.power(intraday_ret.clip(lower=0), 2)
    down_vol = np.power(intraday_ret.clip(upper=0), 2)
    asym = up_vol.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean() - down_vol.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    vol_short = df_copy["volume"].rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_medium = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_accel = (vol_short / vol_medium.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(1.0)
    df_copy["factor_vol_asymmetry_highvol_accel"] = asym * np.where(is_high_vol > 0, vol_accel, 1.0)
    return df_copy["factor_vol_asymmetry_highvol_accel"]
description: Preserves the core volatility asymmetry mechanism from the first parent (difference between exponentially weighted upside and downside squared intraday returns). Borrows the volume acceleration measure (short-term vs medium-term volume mean) from the second parent, but applies it only on days classified as high-volume by the alpha_tools volume regime module (from the first parent). This conditional gating aims to amplify the directional signal during high-conviction high-volume periods while avoiding unnecessary scaling on normal days, targeting improved ICIR and RankICIR without sacrificing the cross-sectional predictive power.
